skeleton.label: IPA-inspired structure (not an official IPA template)

REQ.2: Position of this document and its sources

BD.2: Position of this document and its sources

DD.2: Position of this document and its sources
DD.8: Conditions and results of each transition

empty.nodes: The selection contains no building blocks.
empty.entities: The selection contains no data tables.
empty.interfaces: The selection contains no external interfaces.
empty.machines: The selection contains no state machines.
empty.acceptance: No acceptance item can be derived from the selection.
empty.constraints: No constraint has been declared for this selection.

facts_note: This document is derived mechanically from the validated atlas model; each statement comes from an authored fact.
A value nobody authored is shown as a NOT-AUTHORED marker. Nothing is guessed, defaulted or filled in.
Acceptance items are derived from expected end states, expected results and test ids; their quality equals the quality of those fields.

signoff.judgement: The document is approved only when every marker above is resolved and the approver signs.

title.test: Write tests for the sealed cases
title.failure-analysis: Explain a divergence from the design

goal.REQ: Write the requirements document for the selected elements ({targets}) using only the facts below.
goal.BD: Write the basic design document for the selected elements ({targets}) using only the facts below.
goal.DD: Write the detailed design document for the selected elements ({targets}) using only the facts below.
goal.implement: Implement the selected elements ({targets}) so that every selected case ends in its authored expected state.
goal.test: Write automated tests for the selected cases ({targets}); each test asserts the sealed expectation.
goal.failure-analysis: Explain, with the causal chain below, why the run diverged ({targets}), and name the design sections that justify each step.

REQ: The requirements document with the twelve chapters listed under the section structure
A list of every marker left in the text
BD: The basic design document with the twelve chapters listed under the section structure
A list of every marker left in the text
DD: The detailed design document with the twelve chapters listed under the section structure
A list of every marker left in the text
implement: Source changes for the selected elements
A short note mapping each change to an element id
The results of running the selected cases
test: One automated test per selected case
A note on which expectation each test asserts
failure-analysis: A step-by-step explanation that cites element ids and design sections
A list of facts that are missing for a firm conclusion

acceptance.fallback: Select at least one requirement or case to derive acceptance items.
acceptance.no_marker: No marker is left unresolved without being listed in the artifact list.

base: Use only the facts in this prompt; never invent an id, a column, a rule or a number.
When a fact is missing write the marker and list it; do not fill the gap.
Keep every id exactly as written; do not rename or merge elements.
constraints.machine: State machine {id} may only move along the listed transitions; its states are: {states}.
constraints.dedup: Element {id} handles duplicate keys with mode {mode}.
constraints.aggregator: Element {id} tolerates failed sections and ends degraded instead of failed.
constraints.tbd: Open decision {id} is unresolved: do not decide it; keep it listed.

prompts.empty: This prompt type needs a sealed expectation first: author the expectation of each selected case, then ask again. Nothing has been generated.
rules: Cite element ids in code spans.
